_note: The rules of scripts/analyze-facts.jq and the open issues that already describe them. A finding comments on the first of these that is still open; when all are closed it files a new issue with this title.

fixer-outside-module.title: A fixer in an issue run can change files outside the issue and they are committed into its PR

noop-fixers.title: Fixers in an issue run resume the implementer on Opus even for failures outside its files

cache-rewrite-on-resume.title: A fixer that resumes the implementer re-writes the implementer's conversation cache because its answer schema differs

restart-overwrites-records.title: Restarting an issue run in the same worktree overwrites its implement and heal records, so budgets and yk stats undercount

records-undercount.title: Restarting an issue run in the same worktree overwrites its implement and heal records, so budgets and yk stats undercount

healed-field-mismatch.title: RESULT of an issue run says healed=- although its fixers made changes
